aiReviews.claim: Decline Code must be alphanumeric and must not exceed 2 bytes.
aiReviews.sourceDetail: Element 26 is Character Type AN, maximum length two bytes, and fixed length of two alphanumeric characters. The AI captures character class and maximum but omits fixed length.

aiReviews.claim: Decline Code must be one of: 2D, 3A, 3F, CB, FZ, I1, I2, I3, KS, W2, W3, 4I, 6C, 4M.
aiReviews.sourceDetail: All 14 listed codes occur in Appendix H, but in multiple distinct contexts: 11 in the re-entry table, 4I/6C for timed-out transactions, and 4M for TransArmor token retrieval. Element 26 says 'Any valid Decline Code'; Appendix H is not declared to be the exhaustive set of all valid decline codes. The claim's generic 'must be one of' therefore is not established as complete.

sourceEvidence.quote: Character Type: AN Maximum Length: 2 bytes
